EC1: Known hypersensitivity to paracetamol [OR] or mannitol (excipient with known effect)
EC2: Severe hepatocellular insufficiency (ASAT [OR] or ALAT [OR] > 5N, or bilirubin > 2N)
EC3: Pharmacological intervention [OR] (administration of corticosteroids [OR], NSAIDs [OR] or paracetamol) or physical intervention (external cooling technique) that may influence temperature in the last 6 hours.
